panels.name: Hall of the Crafters and gated descent
Khaz’goroth’s Seat and Ancient Treasure vault

markers.to: 02:I ↔ 03:I; approach to Hall of the Crafters
03:I ↔ 03:II; gated descending passage to Archaedas; exact bends uncertain

uncertain: The descending corridor C has confirmed endpoints but unverified ramp bends and vertical alignment; its geometry is dashed.
The approach and treasure-vault dimensions are schematic; Q10 is approximate within the vault.
Exact vertical overlap between the upper and lower chambers is intentionally not asserted.
notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
The four small unnumbered circles represent the Hall of the Crafters guardian event, not additional named bosses. The square is its altar.
The gate beyond the guardian event leads toward Archaedas. The vault opens after Archaedas is defeated.
Q9 also serves Find the Gems and Power Source.
No return teleporter is asserted. Return through the cleared passages.
